items.defectStatement: The distribution tests exercise feature-disabled rejection only for the metadata subcommand. Removing or breaking the check subcommand's feature guard would therefore escape this coverage.
obligations: Exercise the check subcommand without enabling rolling-updates.
Assert the disabled-feature diagnostic and exit code 4.
Preserve the existing metadata coverage and production feature guard.
items.notes: Uses the requested no-code-fix category for missing tests elsewhere. The cited production guard is correct; the remedy belongs in the distribution tests, which this item's frozen input does not show.
